messages:
maria: Heads-up: I'm about to run a synthetic load sweep across eu-west-1 GPU pools to validate admission controller thresholds for a 2h window. Goal: find the point where queues start to grow and where the rate-limiter kicks in. Anyone on call?
aj: Oncall, watching. Do you want me to pin a dashboard? link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/ingress?orgId=1 (I'll open trace span when it starts)
maria: Yes plz. Using loadgen v0.9.2 -> `loadgen run --profile=gpu-heavy --concurrency=200 --rps=6000 --region=eu-west-1` (will ramp 10m->30m->60m) Starting at 15:30 UTC
kevin: FYI set admission.soft_limit to 0.75 in eu-west-1 staging yesterday. Prod is 0.8. For this test we should try both. Can we run prod config first then flip to staging config?
olga: I can flip a routing policy to shadow requests to a canary pool if needed. But we should tag the runs with `test/backpressure/2026-03-18` so logs filter cleanly.
maria: Good point. I'll tag. Starting ramp in 2m. @aj please monitor queue_time_p50/p95, gpu_util and admission_rejections metric. I'm particularly watching kvcache hit ratio impact under saturation.
sre-bot: ALERT: auto-scaler suppressed new nodes in eu-west-1 due to quota. (info) Suggest checking cloud quota before heavy runs.
aj: Saw that. @maria can you pause 30s — quota needs 1 extra quota increase request. I can temporarily adjust the run to 75% of target while we confirm.
maria: Paused. Changing target to rps=4500. Will restart in 3m. @kevin if we hit queueing, try toggling admission.mode from 'drop' to 'throttle' for one run.
kevin: ack. After first sweep, I'll flip to throttle for run 2 and capture latency tail. Will also enable per-route rate-limit logs.
maria: Restarting now with rps=4500. Ramp 10m->30m.
aj: Dashboard live: CPU/GPU histograms and per-GPU queue depth. p95 queue_time jumped from 45ms to 800ms around 86% GPU util. admission.rejections spiked right after. Sharing screenshot in #random soon :camera_with_flash:
olga: noted. kvcache hit dropped 18% at peak, likely due to batch eviction under pressure. We should consider keeping cache hot for common prefixes.
maria: Run summary: at prod config (0.8) observed queue buildup at 86% util, p95 latency 1.2s, admission rejections increased 4x. With staging config (0.75) earlier rejection curve started at 78% and kept p95 under 700ms but throughput dropped 15%.
kevin: Conclusion: soft_limit=0.75 yields better tail latency at cost of throughput. Ops call: propose default soft_limit=0.75 for eu-west-1 and add auto-escalation for short bursts up to 0.82 when kvcache_hit>0.6. Does that sound ok?
aj: Sounds reasonable. Two requests: (1) add an automated load test to run weekly during low traffic, (2) add alert when queue_p95 > 500ms for >3min.
maria: I'll file the follow-ups. tagging sprints. Thanks team :thumbsup:
